name: tiledlayout
expr: tiledlayout(2, 3); nexttile; plot([1 2 3], [1 2 3]); nexttile; plot([1 2 3], [3 2 1]); nexttile(5); plot([1 2 3], [1 4 9]); a = 1; b = 2; c = 3;
comment: tiledlayout / nexttile — modern subplot API. Display-only, no scalar return; fingerprint just confirms the workspace stays clean (a, b, c are local set-and-read scalars). Cell layout + figure structure is e2e.
